Trail Technology · Unit 7: Electricity · Module 2

Electric Charge and Electric Field

Charge, conductors and insulators, Coulomb’s law and electric fields.

Lesson coming

The question

Why does a jacket crackle when you pull it off after a cold, dry ride?

The physics

  • Electric charge
  • Conservation of charge
  • Conductors and insulators
  • Electrostatic force
  • Electric fields
  • Charge distribution

The math

  • F = kq₁q₂ / r²
  • E = F / q

Learning objectives

  • Describe positive and negative charge, and conservation of charge
  • Tell conductors and insulators apart
  • Use Coulomb’s law
  • Draw and interpret electric field lines

The mountain biking connection

Static charge builds up when materials rub. Bikes use conductors for wiring and insulators to protect it.

Learning activities

Learning activities for this topic are being developed.

The skills above show what this topic covers. In the meantime, the Lab has standalone tools you can explore.
